persona.background_type: retail banking relationship manager, brief résumé
persona.notes: Relationship manager at a bank; does not manage a team. Portfolio sizes, targets and customer data are confidential. Résumé is brief, so ask for details instead of assuming them.

resume_text:
Rhea D'Souza (synthetic)
Relationship Manager, a private-sector bank, Mumbai (2021-present). Manage a portfolio of about 180 customers; reached 112% of my annual target in the last year.
Customer Service Officer, same bank (2020-2021).
B.Com, a college in Mumbai, 2019, 75%. Completed the banking exam certification in 2020.
Skills: Customer relationships, product knowledge in deposits, insurance and loans, MS Excel. Languages: English, Hindi, Konkani.
background: Five years in retail banking, currently a relationship manager. I do not manage a team.
goal: Move into a business or product role in wealth management, then lead a branch cluster.

answers.text: I've worked in retail banking for five years, the last four as a relationship manager at a private-sector bank in Mumbai. I manage a portfolio of about 180 customers and reached 112% of my annual target last year. I started in customer service, and I know how customers react when a product is mis-sold. I want an MBA to move from selling individual products to designing the products and the customer segments.
I can't share the portfolio size in rupees or any customer details. Banking secrecy rules and the bank's code of conduct forbid that. The 112% is the figure I am allowed to say.
I build strong customer relationships and I always put the customer at the centre. My approach is solutions-oriented and I constantly strive to exceed expectations.
I'm sorry, I also can't tell you the target I was given or the bank's market share. These are internal numbers and we aren't allowed to disclose them.
I don't know how many of my customers were with another bank first. We don't record where the relationship came from, so I'd just be guessing.
